cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our cakes tied. Next round: one-handed icing. Loser cleans the kitchen. Keep your other hand behind your back, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could just share the prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's distributing it, not deciding it. I'll time the icing; finish means the whole top is covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no icing left. We used it all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then wash our mixing bowls one-handed. First grease-free bowl wins; loser dries both. Please wait for my inspection before you call yours finished.
